summary.name: Postorius
summary.one_liner: Postorius is a Django-based web user interface for administering GNU Mailman 3 mailing lists.
use_cases: administering GNU Mailman mailing lists through a browser
running a self-hosted mailing list server
providing a web interface for list members
summary.what_it_does: Postorius is a Django app that provides a web user interface to access GNU Mailman. It is part of the GNU Mailman Suite and needs a running GNU Mailman 3.3.10 instance to work. The page describes it as free software released under the GNU Lesser General Public License version 3. It requires Python 3.11 or later and Django 5.2 or later. The page does not list specific features beyond providing access to Mailman through the web.
notable: Web front end for GNU Mailman 3
Part of the GNU Mailman Suite
Licensed under LGPL version 3 (listed as GPL-3.0 on awesome-selfhosted)
caveats: Requires a running GNU Mailman 3.3.10 instance
